_comment: Copy this file to config/sources.local.json (gitignored) and list your belief graphs. Paths may be absolute or relative to this file. 'registries' are collections.json files (namespaced collections, resolved with depends_on closures); 'graphs' are standalone beliefs.json files at any path. Env overrides also work: CB_COLLECTIONS adds a registry, CB_BELIEFS adds a single graph. The viewer ships with no default — until a source is configured here (or via env), no graphs load.
